description:
Outcome: The coordinator receives one daily email listing new problem reports, from owner notification decision.
Scope: Garden-timezone schedule, durable batches/cursor, unique report membership, retries and operational visibility. Include newly created reports even if now resolved, with status and authenticated links but no gardener contacts.
Excludes: Immediate notifications and gardener notification emails.
Acceptance: Since-last-success reports included in batch accounting; subsequent batches exclude previously accounted reports. Empty day sends nothing. Concurrent runs cannot duplicate a batch; scheduler downtime catches up. Failed batch stays available for retry; ambiguous delivery is surfaced for reconciliation rather than falsely marked successful.
Behaviour: No lost unsent reports on failure/restart; expose uncertain provider acknowledgement; do not claim exactly-once SMTP delivery.
Verification: Fake clock/mail tests for date boundary/DST, failure/restart/catch-up/concurrency and ambiguous delivery; sandbox delivered email plus report retry membership test.
Prerequisites: T-001, T-013.
Assumptions: 08:00 garden local time; use provider idempotency if available; owner provides email service credentials.
title: Send daily new-problem email digest
